subject: Media Literacy
title: Citizen Journalism
description: A quick win: understand Citizen Journalism.

hook.text: A bystander's smartphone video of police brutality sparked a global movement. No journalist was present.

buildup.text: Citizen journalism means ordinary people report news using phones, blogs, and social media.

discovery.text: Events like the Arab Spring showed that citizen reporters can break stories before any newsroom.

twist.text: But citizen journalists lack training in verification and ethics. Speed without accuracy spreads misinformation.

climax.text: The power to publish is universal. The skill to publish responsibly still isn't.

punchline.text: Everyone can report the news now. Not everyone knows how.

quiz.question: What is a key challenge of citizen journalism?
options: Lack of training in verification and ethics can spread misinformation
